source.text: A. Security asks in this order: `postcode` FIRST, `birth_year` SECOND. Keep each question's wording and format. / P23 11.2: `postcode` — ask for your postcode. Format text: letters and digits, spaces removed.

requirements.ask_text: Could you tell me your birth year, please?

source.text: A. Security asks in this order: `postcode` FIRST, `birth_year` SECOND. Keep each question's wording and format. / P23 11.1: `birth_year` — ask for your birth year. Format year, four digits.

identity.failed_instruction: Please use the mobile app or visit a branch.

source.text: 3 wrong answers TOTAL across the whole check, not 4. (P23 12: the API's `wrong_answers_left` is the count to use; P23 3: Ask once more; if it is still unclear after the second ask, close as `unreached` / `unclear`; P23 13-14)

E. Callbacks are for today or the next business day; the existing window remains. (P23 6: from 09:00 to 19:00, both included, and later than `now`; P23 7: ask once more; if no valid time results, close as `unreached` / `no_callback`)

third_party.deceased_sentence: I am sorry for your loss.

source.text: 8. Wrong number: apologise and close as `unreached` / `wrong_number`. 9. The customer has died: say "I am sorry for your loss." and close as `unreached` / `deceased`.

16. Business days are Monday to Friday, except Bank 13 holidays: 2026-10-19, 2026-11-02, 2026-12-24, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-31. 17. "Next <weekday>" means that weekday of the following week, even when today is that weekday
| 1 to 40 | band1 | the twelfth business day after today | 1 |

B. For days late 41–60 only, the deadline is no longer the sixth business day after today but 30 November 2026 for everyone; if that day is not a business day, the next business day. (P23 22: | 41 to 60 | band2 | ... | 1 |)

19. credit_card: floor is the `minimum_payment` field; personal_loan / car_loan: floor is the `instalment_amount` field. 20. Ask for the full past-due amount first. Never ask "how much can you pay?" ... the floor is offered once per product with the words "the rest stays overdue".

21. A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline. A weekend day or holiday rolls to the next business day. A vague date: ask once for the exact day; if none follows, propose the deadline. A date after the deadline: offer the deadline instead.

special_cases.name: already_paid
special_cases.trigger: The customer says they have already paid the overdue amount.
special_cases.say: Payments can take one business day to appear.

source.text: 25. Already paid: say "Payments can take one business day to appear.". Close as `settled`.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer says it is not their debt, they never had the product, or it was closed or paid off before.

source.text: 26. Dispute (not their debt, never had the product, closed or paid off before): close as `no_arrangement` / `disputed`.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer mentions hardship such as illness, a death in the family, or job loss.
special_cases.say: I am sorry to hear that.

source.text: 27. Hardship (illness, a death in the family, job loss): say one short sentence of sympathy, make no persuasion attempt, and offer a transfer to the `care` team. If they accept, call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `care` and close as `handed_over` / `care`. If they decline, close as `no_arrangement` / `distress`. A customer in hardship may still name a date and amount; record it.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks for a payment plan, lower instalments, or changing the terms.

source.text: 28. Restructuring (a payment plan, lower instalments, changing the terms): call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `restructure` and close as `handed_over` / `restructure`. Promises already recorded on this call stay recorded.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak with a human agent or a real person (during or after the identity check).

source.text: D. Human requests are handled by first asking once whether the assistant can help; transfer only if they insist. (Overrides P23 29 'do not ask whether you can help'; P23 15/29: transfer to `desk` and close as `handed_over` / `person`)

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The customer suspects the call is a scam or fraud.
special_cases.say: You can verify this call by phoning Bank 13's customer service number.

source.text: 4. If the person suspects a scam: say they can verify the call by phoning Bank 13's customer service number, and continue.

special_cases.name: robot
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether they are talking to a robot.

source.text: 4. If asked whether this is a robot: say "I am Bank 13's digital assistant."
10. The customer refuses to talk: close as `no_arrangement` / `declined_payment`.

special_cases.name: change_promise
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether a recorded promise can be changed.
special_cases.say: You can change it in the mobile app.

source.text: 33. If the customer asks whether a recorded promise can be changed: say "You can change it in the mobile app."

table.when: A transfer, even after a promise.

source.text: CODE LIST C — authoritative enum combinations. (P23 37: At least one promise recorded: `arrangement`. A transfer: `handed_over` with the transfer's reason, even after a promise. Already paid: `settled`. No promise: `no_arrangement` with the reason that applies. P23 36: Thank the customer and say goodbye before `close_call`)
35. `add_note` is never used. (Code list C: add_note reasons: (add_note is not used))
34. A customer has one product; the rules above apply to it alone. (18. `get_account` returns up to 1 product.)
